description.subtitle: PSG Nike Polo - White
description.intro: The Nike PSG Dri-Fit 2.0 Polo combines casual elegance and functional performance. Inspired by the club's competitive spirit, it offers a sophisticated look with the comfort of Nike technical fabric.
key_benefits: PSG design: Details of the Parisian club that show your loyalty in style.
Active comfort: Nike Dri-FIT technology that maintains breathability.
Versatile aesthetics: Ideal for everyday use or to cheer on the team with elegance.
Classic collar: Button placket that adds a more formal touch to the sporty look.
Freedom of movement: Tight cut that does not limit mobility.

source.subtitle: Polo Nike del PSG - blanco

key_benefits: Diseño del PSG: Detalles del club parisino que muestran tu fidelidad con estilo.
Confort activo: Tecnología Nike Dri-FIT que mantiene la transpirabilidad.
Estética versátil: Ideal para el día a día o para animar al equipo con elegancia.
Cuello clásico: Tapeta con botones que aporta un toque más formal al look deportivo.
